iti62:2.1: Found at [dn33:1.10.111]() and [sn48.23:1.3](), this went on to become a standard Abhidhamma set. The exact meaning is not immediately obvious, and the verses here offer our best clues.
iti62:2.3: The key term is _aññā_ (“enlightenment”), which is used throughout the Suttas to indicate the realization of arahantship specifically. | “The faculty of understanding that one’s enlightenment is imminent” is literally, “The faculty aware that ‘I shall know the unknown’”.
iti62:3.4: This verse establishes that the first faculty is the knowledge of one who has already entered the noble path, and who knows that they will become fully enlightened in the same lifetime.
iti62:4.4: This verse shows that the second faculty is the occasion when arahantship is realized.
iti62:5.4: The final faculty is the arahant living out their last life in peace.
